name: us2-team-managed-discovery
description: Team-managed (next-gen) project discovery: project-owned objects, Epic/Sub-task hierarchy only, and the project's own estimation field ranked (never the global Story Points, research §3). Discovery parity is asserted directly in tests/bash/sink/test_discovery_team.bats; this golden scenario is wired end-to-end through the config command in US1.
